description: This file defines the GameService class that manages Tic Tac Toe games in memory using a thread-safe store.

classes.name: GameService
classes.description: Manages Tic Tac Toe games with operations to create and manipulate game state.

methods.name: CreateGame
methods.description: Creates a new game with an empty 3x3 board and stores it in memory.

methods.name: GetGame
methods.description: Retrieves a game by its unique identifier.

methods.name: TryMakeMove
methods.description: Attempts to apply a move to the game, validating conditions and updating the game state accordingly.

methods.name: BuildStatus
methods.description: Builds a GameStatusResponse DTO from the current state of the game.
